meta.defaultTitle: Egypt Gas Fittings | Precision Gas Fittings Made to British Standards
meta.description: EGF manufactures brass and stainless steel gas fittings and accessories to British Standards in Badr Industrial Zone, Cairo. ISO 9001 certified, supplying Egypt's natural gas distribution companies and export markets.

hero.imageAlt: EGF brass gas fittings, meter connectors and flexible hoses

quality.title: Reliable Quality
quality.text: Every fitting is checked against British Standard specifications before it is released.

precision.title: Precision Manufacturing
precision.text: CNC and transfer-line machining hold tight tolerances on bores, threads and sealing faces.

safety.title: Safer Communities
safety.text: Leak-tight joints and dependable performance in the homes and networks we supply.

products.title: Fittings and Accessories for Every Gas Connection
products.intro: Brass, stainless steel and nickel-plated steel fittings manufactured to British Standard dimensions and thread forms.

capabilities.title: Precision from Raw Material to Finished Part
capabilities.intro: One integrated production floor with CNC machining, automated welding and in-house corrugated hose forming.

quality.title: Quality Built into the Process
quality.intro: Certified management systems, recognised standards and a dedicated quality control laboratory.

certificates.title: Certified Quality, Approved Products
certificates.intro: An ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, hoses tested and approved by the Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality, and registration as an approved supplier of the Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company.

iso9001.title: ISO 9001:2015
iso9001.issuer: Quality management system certificate from OSS Middle East, EGAC accredited

eosIso10380.title: EOS Certificate of Conformity
eosIso10380.issuer: Corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, 3/4 inch, to ISO 10380:2012

eosBs669.title: EOS Batch Conformity Certificate
eosBs669.issuer: Flexible gas appliance hoses, 1/2 inch, to BS 669-1:2022

egas.title: EGAS Supplier Registration
egas.issuer: Approved vendor of the Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company for seven activities

clients.title: Trusted by Egypt's Gas Distribution Network
clients.intro: Ongoing supply to licensed natural gas distribution companies, and export to the UAE.

standard.title: Manufacturing to Standard
standard.text: Every product is produced according to British Standard specifications.

export.title: Export & Logistics
export.text: Packaging and logistics support for shipments to export markets, including the UAE (Sharjah).

distribution.title: Distribution Supply
distribution.text: Ongoing supply to Egypt's licensed natural gas distribution companies, at production volume.

cnc.title: CNC Technology
cnc.text: Removes manual variation from the dimensions that matter most on a gas fitting: bores, threads and sealing faces, for tight tolerances batch after batch.

welding.title: TIG, Laser & CO2 Welding
welding.text: Automated welding lines produce the clean, consistent, leak-tight seams that gas-carrying joints require, at full production scale.

transfer.title: Transfer Machines
transfer.text: Carries each fitting through several machining operations in one continuous cycle: fast, repeatable and high-volume.

hose.title: Corrugated Hose Line
hose.text: Forms stainless steel corrugated flexible hoses and expansion bellows to a controlled pitch, for consistent flexibility and fatigue life.

1.title: Material Intake & Inspection
1.text: Brass, stainless steel and nickel-plated steel stock is received and checked before it enters production.

2.title: Machining: CNC & Transfer Lines
2.text: Fitting bodies and components are machined on CNC and transfer machine lines for tight, repeatable tolerances.

3.title: Welding & Forming
3.text: TIG, laser and CO2 automatic welding join and shape components into finished fittings.

4.title: Hose & Bellow Forming
4.text: A dedicated line produces stainless steel corrugated flexible hoses and expansion bellows in-house.

5.title: Quality Inspection
5.text: Finished fittings are checked against British Standard specifications before they are approved for release.

6.title: Packaging & Dispatch
6.text: Approved products are packaged and prepared for delivery to local distributors and export markets.

integrated.title: Integrated Production
integrated.text: Machining, welding and hose-forming all take place in-house, with no subcontracted manufacturing steps.

everyStage.title: Quality at Every Stage
everyStage.text: Incoming material, in-process and final checks are built into the production flow.
